notes.title: New game update: 1.14.0
notes.content: [p]Hey people! It is being a while, but I've been working hard all this time! This update comes with many improvements from player's feedback, mostly quality of life improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Changelog:[/p][list][*][p][b]Combat Options[/b] (options on the right side of the action bar + options on the bottom-right corner of the screen)[/p][list][*][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed icons and the UI[/p][/*][*][p]Icon showing the currently selected option[/p][/*][*][p]Text showing the command[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mechanics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Strike Styles:[/p][list][*][p]Adjustments to bonuses and penalties[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage of straight attacks, lower hit chance, higher damage variability[/p][/*][*][p]Random Style: the chance to pick a style is now 50% (no weapon-specific chances)[/p][/*][*][p]Dual wielding: both attacks are now restricted to the same style (+ new double straight attack animation)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Defense Priority:[/p][list][*][p]Blocking defenses have a bonus against swing attacks[/p][/*][*][p]No penalties; no block after a dodge when dodge is selected[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Give up attack to defend: more safety time when attacking while being attacked[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Combat stance animations specific to each Strike Style[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Combat Modes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Strong: 10% attack penalty[/p][/*][*][p]Defensive: allows attacks (with penalty), causes hesitation[/p][/*][*][p]Combat stance animations specific to each Combat Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Perforation damage now scales 50% less with Strength. This improves the Fast Attack mode, as strike strength reduction does not lower the damage as much.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Options[/b][/p][list][*][p]Invert mouse x/y[/p][/*][*][p]Brightness[/p][/*][*][p]Buttons on sliders[/p][/*][*][p]Font/UI size[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-highlight interactables (default option, only shows the name of the interactable)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Game Paused indicator[/p][/*][*][p]UIMode key indicator[/p][/*][*][p]HP indicator below the creature’s name[/p][/*][*][p]Scrollbar in resolution dropdown (when it is long enough)[/p][/*][*][p]Hyperlinks: highlighted interactable text which opens a description when clicked[/p][/*][*][p]Improved target switching in Free Cam Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Accuracy shown on mouse pointer when hovering over an enemy[/p][/*][*][p]Added command keys to tooltips of the left-side icons[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Audio pauses when the game is paused[/p][/*][*][p]Music volume reduced during cinematic dialogues[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Party[/b][/p][list][*][p]Companion aggro range reduced[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Map[/b][/p][list][*][p]Map icons: quest target, companion, NPC, merchant, region[/p][/*][*][p]Custom markers[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial[/b][/p][list][*][p]Starting tutorial with the basics, training with Allan[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial panel reorganized into a tree view[/p][/*][*][p]New entries[/p][/*][*][p]Most tutorial messages now appear at rest places[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Plenty of minor bugfixes and imporvements of all kinds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]A second update: the first area of Chapter 1 was developed, but it is [b]not [/b]included in the demo. It contains new enemies, like barbarians, goblins, a juvenile dragon, and, of course, stronger cultists. After this update, I will focus again on developing Chapter 1, so you won't see updates for some time here on Steam. [/p]

notes.title: New Update: 1.7.0
notes.content:
Hello Elengardians! This update comes with with the manual combat and some new effect mechanics!

Changelog:

[list]
[*] Manual combat: a new game mode that requires you to click for each attack and hold the right mouse button to defend. The game mechanics remain the same. This is still not the mentioned Action Mode. The survey was updated to reflect this change.
[*] 	New states/effects
[list][*] 		Torpor mechanics: torpor is now a generic state that can be caused by anything. It reduces Strength, defenses and willpower. When torpor level reaches 100%, the target is unconscious. Current Asyum spells use torpor mechanics now.
[*] 		Daze mechanics: daze is a generic state that can be caused by anything. It reduces Motor Skills and adds a chance for the character to fall. It is currently caused by Electric Stun
[*] 		Electric Stun: electric damage may cause Electric Stun, which causes Daze and may make the target unconscious
[*] 		Weapon overweight: now the character can always hold a weapon with one hand (no forced two hand grip), but there are penalties[/list]
[*] 	Balancing/adjustments:
[list][*] 		Reduced damage of some weapons
[*] 		Reduced chance of consecutive staggers
[*] 		Decreased attack of area attacks

notes.title: Demo launched and development update #1!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I am glad to announce that the first playable demo has been launched! The game is currently on a pre-alpha development stage, near to reaching alpha stage.
This demo aims to provide a gameplay sample of the game with the minimal features expected to be in the final game. All content is not final, especially the audiovisual assets, but even so, the demo contents can provide a fair notion of the game’s proposal. 

Give it a try and let a feedback here or on Discord!

The main changes and improvements expected for the future are:

- Adding new abilities: the ability trees are incomplete, even the ones for Soldier and Wizard, which are currently the ones with more abilities. Also, the game is expected to have superpowerfull abilities, since one of the main goals is to give the players the possibility to create demigod-like characters, in terms of power.

- Improving UI, especially the icons: ability icons are not in tune with the expected graphics style and will be replaced.

- Improving character models: they are going to be replaced by more realistic ones.

- Adding more non-human creatures: many mythological creatures are expected to be added, emphasizing dragons, elemental spirits and reptile-bird hybrids.

- Custom soundtrack

There are also plans for adding a “Soft Survival” system, in which you spend time for Rest Place actions, like learning knowledges and abilities, and passing time requires supplies to survive. Other possible additions are a lot of minor changes and improvements on the combat mechanics. But all of these will depend on the game’s reception and the speed of the development.

For now, the roadmap is:
1)	Marketing, gathering feedback, demo maintenance
2)	Review and design the remaining game features and the game levels
3)	Investigate the possibility of crowdfunding
4)	Implement the levels
5)	Implement the final features and improvements
Steps 4 and 5 are interchangeable.

Feel free to get in touch for any questions and suggestions!

Stèphano M. M. G.
